claims: Informally, "real" is used as an adverb to mean "very".
Real wages indicate figures adjusted for inflation to show true purchasing power.
Real GDP indicates figures adjusted for inflation to show true purchasing power.
Real numbers include all rational and irrational numbers.
Real numbers represent any point on a continuous number line.
Real property is land and buildings.
"Real life" refers to actual existence, as opposed to fiction.
"Keep it real" means to be authentic or true to oneself.
"The real McCoy" is the genuine article.
